svg.text: pub struct Cols_pre { pub n: usize, pub line: Vec<i64> }

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: pub open spec fn valid_cols_pre(pre: &Cols_pre) -> bool {

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: &&& pre.line@.len() == pre.n as int

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: &&& pre.n as int <= ROW_CAP_pre as int // catalog cap, re-checked at load

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < pre.n as int ==> // catalog value bounds, re-checked at load

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: pre.line@[i] as int >= -8191 && pre.line@[i] as int <= 8191

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: pub open spec fn sum_total(pre: &Cols_pre, i0: int) -> int // the SQL, as a fold

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: decreases pre.n as int - i0

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: { if i0 < 0 || i0 >= pre.n as int { 0int }

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: else { (if row_hit(pre, i0) { sum_total_val(pre, i0) } else { 0int }) + sum_total(pre, i0 + 1) } }

svg.text: pub fn run_query(pre: &Cols_pre) -> (res: Vec<OutRow>)

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: requires valid_cols_pre(pre),

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: ensures res@.len() == 1, // shown split; emitted as one conjunction

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: (exists|i0: int| row_hit(pre, i0)) ==> res@[0].total is Some

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: && res@[0].total->Some_0 as int == sum_total(pre, 0),

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: !(exists|i0: int| row_hit(pre, i0)) ==> res@[0].total is None,

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: // AGENT_EDIT_START

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: let mut acc: i128 = 0; let mut any: bool = false; let mut i: usize = pre.n;

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: while i > 0

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: invariant

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: i <= pre.n, valid_cols_pre(pre),

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: acc as int == sum_total(pre, i as int),

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: -((pre.n - i) as int) * 0x8000_0000_0000_0000int <= acc as int,

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: acc as int <= ((pre.n - i) as int) * 0x8000_0000_0000_0000int,

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: any <==> exists|i0: int| i as int <= i0 && row_hit(pre, i0),

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: decreases i,

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: i -= 1; let line = pre.line[i];

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: proof { /* three asserts elided */ reveal_with_fuel(sum_total, 2); }

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: if line > 5 { acc = acc + (line as i128); any = true; }

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: let mut res: Vec<OutRow> = Vec::new();

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: res.push(OutRow { total: if any { Some(acc) } else { None } }); res

text.font-family: Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: // AGENT_EDIT_END
